pages.speaker: npc
lines: Ooh, your Pokémon are so very charming! How enchanting! They're so charming I will even hang a picture of one right beside me! I'm only doing this especially for you! Exciting, don't you think? Dress up your Pokémon in my boudoir and make it a sight to behold! I will snap a photo when you're done. You will do this, won't you?
